## Outcome

Who needs this and what should they be able to do or decide?

## Ownership and roadmap

Link the parent issue or gate. Select the lead group label. Set the assignee when someone takes the task. List any dependency and the decision or input needed from it.

## Work

- [ ] Describe the smallest action that delivers the outcome.

## Evidence for closure

State the observable result. For technical changes, link the revision, profile, relevant checks and known limits. For discovery, use approved aggregate counts or an approved reference to privately held evidence.
